title: Template-free synthesis of a multilayer manganese oxide/graphene oxide nanoflake-modified carbon felt as an anode material for microbial fuel cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1540-1548
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07323A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lizhen Zeng, Lixia Zhang
A novel multilayer nanoflake structure of γ-MnO2/GO, synthesized via a simple template-free chemical precipitation method, was employed to modify a carbon felt electrode as an anode material for achieving a high-performance microbial fuel cell.
